def road_element(road_id, name, x, y, heading, junction, predecessor, successor):

    link += "</link>"
    lane_links = '<link><predecessor id="-1"/><successor id="-1"/></link>'
    return f'''<road id="{road_id}" name="{name}" length="40" junction="{junction}">{link}

def road():

            (251, "eastbound junction connector", -20, 0, 0, 1, ("road", 250), ("road", 252)),
            (252, "eastbound departure highway A", 20, 0, 0, -1, ("junction", 1), None)]
    north = [(253, "northbound approach highway B", 0, -60, math.pi/2, -1, None, ("junction", 1)),
             (254, "northbound junction connector", 0, -20, math.pi/2, 1, ("road", 253), ("road", 255)),
             (255, "northbound departure highway B", 0, 20, math.pi/2, -1, ("junction", 1), None)]
    roads = "".join(road_element(*row) for row in east + north)
    junction = '''<junction id="1" name="uncontrolled crossed highways">

            'north="60" south="-60" east="60" west="-60" vendor="worker"/>' + roads + junction + '</OpenDRIVE>\n')


def ego_station(t, speed, yielding, stop):
    approach_time = 25 / speed
    if stop:
        return min(-50 + speed*t, -25), "stop_before_entry" if t >= approach_time else "approach"
    if yielding and t >= approach_time:
        if t < approach_time + 1:
            return -25, "yield_wait"
        t -= 1
    station = min(-50 + speed*t, 50)
    return station, "approach" if station < -20 else "intersection" if station < 20 else "departure"


def rows(suffix, candidate):
    speed, _, stop = POLICIES[candidate]

        out.append({"frame": frame, "time_s": t,
                    "requested_ego_xyz_m": [round(ego_x, 6), -1.75, 0],
                    "requested_other_xyz_m": [1.75, round(other_y, 6), 0],
                    "requested_ego_heading_rad": 0,
                    "requested_other_heading_rad": round(math.pi/2, 9),
                    "requested_ego_speed_mps": 0 if phase in ("yield_wait", "stop_before_entry") else speed if ego_x < 50 else 0,
                    "requested_other_speed_mps": 5 if other_y < 50 else 0,
                    "requested_ego_phase": phase, "requested_other_phase": "approach" if other_y < -20 else "intersection" if other_y < 20 else "departure",
                    "requested_yield_action": yielding, "authored_official_device_count": 0,
                    "original_native_observed": False, "legal_verdict": None})
    return out

def topology(path):
    root = ET.parse(path).getroot()
    roads = {int(row.attrib["id"]): row for row in root.findall("road")}
    if set(roads) != {250, 251, 252, 253, 254, 255}:
        raise ValueError("Six road regions required")
    if {int(roads[x].attrib["junction"]) for x in (251, 254)} != {1} or \
            any(int(roads[x].attrib["junction"]) != -1 for x in (250, 252, 253, 255)):
        raise ValueError("Junction connector topology")
    for ids, origin, heading in (((250, 251, 252), (-60, 0), 0),
                                 ((253, 254, 255), (0, -60), math.pi/2)):
        for index, road_id in enumerate(ids):
            geometry = roads[road_id].find("./planView/geometry")
            if (geometry is None or geometry.find("line") is None or
                    abs(float(geometry.attrib["length"]) - 40) > 1e-9 or
                    abs(float(geometry.attrib["hdg"]) - heading) > 1e-9 or
                    math.dist((float(geometry.attrib["x"]), float(geometry.attrib["y"])),
                              (origin[0] + index*40*math.cos(heading),
                               origin[1] + index*40*math.sin(heading))) > 1e-8):
                raise ValueError("Crossed highway endpoint mismatch")
            lane = roads[road_id].find("./lanes/laneSection/right/lane")
            if lane is None or lane.attrib["id"] != "-1" or \
                    abs(float(lane.find("width").attrib["a"]) - 3.5) > 1e-9:
                raise ValueError("Driving-lane geometry mismatch")
    junction = root.find("junction")
    if junction is None or junction.attrib.get("id") != "1":
        raise ValueError("Junction missing")
    connections = {(int(c.attrib["incomingRoad"]), int(c.attrib["connectingRoad"]))
                   for c in junction.findall("connection")}
    if connections != {(250, 251), (253, 254)}:
        raise ValueError("Distinct-highway connections missing")
    if any(road.find("signals/signal") is not None for road in roads.values()):
        raise ValueError("Authored official device would change applicability")


def check(bundle):
    bundle = Path(bundle)
    cfg = json.loads((bundle / "config.json").read_text())
    suffix = cfg["case_id"].split("__")[-1]
    candidate = cfg["candidate_id"]
    if suffix not in CASES or candidate not in POLICIES:
        raise ValueError("Unknown case or candidate")
    if (bundle / "assignment-source.json").read_bytes() != SOURCE.read_bytes() or \
            (bundle / "case-plan.json").read_bytes() != PLAN.read_bytes() or \
            sha(SOURCE) != SOURCE_SHA:
        raise ValueError("Copied frozen source mismatch")
    if (bundle / "crossroads.xodr").read_text() != road() or \
            cfg["road_sha256"] != sha(bundle / "crossroads.xodr"):
        raise ValueError("Authored road mismatch")
    topology(bundle / "crossroads.xodr")
    source = json.loads(SOURCE.read_text())
    speed, camera, stop = POLICIES[candidate]
    if (cfg["assignment_id"] != CASE.name or cfg["assignment_sha256"] != SOURCE_SHA or
            cfg["case_plan_sha256"] != sha(PLAN) or
            cfg["source_text"] != source["law_record"]["text"] or
            cfg["rate_hz"] != 20 or cfg["frames"] != FRAMES or
            cfg["ego_highway_road_ids"] != [250, 251, 252] or
            cfg["right_other_highway_road_ids"] != [253, 254, 255] or
            cfg["requested_speed_mps"] != speed or cfg["camera_policy"] != camera or
            cfg["stop_before_entry"] != stop or cfg["requested_yield_action"] != (suffix == "controlled_1") or
            cfg["status"] != "unselected_native_request" or cfg["original_native_observed"] is not False or
            cfg["legal_verdict"] is not None):
        raise ValueError("Source-bound configuration mismatch")
    track = bundle / "requested-tracks.jsonl"
    if cfg["tracks_sha256"] != sha(track):
        raise ValueError("Track digest mismatch")
    actual = [json.loads(line) for line in track.read_text().splitlines()]
    if len(actual) != FRAMES or actual != rows(suffix, candidate):
        raise ValueError("Requested entry trajectories changed")
    return {"case_id": cfg["case_id"], "candidate": candidate,
            "frames": len(actual), "delivery_ready": False,
            "original_native_observed": False}

def process(bundle, raw_path):
    bundle, raw_path = Path(bundle), Path(raw_path)
    check(bundle)

    raw = json.loads(raw_path.read_text())

            raw.get("case_id") != cfg["case_id"] or raw.get("candidate_id") != cfg["candidate_id"] or
            raw.get("config_sha256") != sha(bundle / "config.json") or

            raw.get("synthetic") is not True or raw.get("original_native_observed") is not False or
            raw.get("human_visibility_reviewed") is not False):
        raise ValueError("Saved source or provenance changed")
    expected = make_raw(bundle)
    if raw != expected or len(raw.get("rows", [])) != FRAMES:
        raise ValueError("Frame, actor, body, source or video join changed")
    ego_entry = other_entry = None

    gap = None if ego_entry is None else round(ego_entry - other_entry, 6)
    return {"format": "c111294-2502-synthetic-saved-v1", "case_id": cfg["case_id"],
            "candidate_id": cfg["candidate_id"], "raw_sha256": sha(raw_path),
            "config_sha256": sha(bundle / "config.json"), "frames_joined": FRAMES,
            "ego_front_entry_s": ego_entry, "other_front_entry_s": other_entry,
            "ego_rear_exit_s": ego_exit, "other_rear_exit_s": other_exit,

            "approximate_same_time_legally_determined": False,
            "official_device_governance_verified": False,
            "right_of_way_legally_determined": False,
            "synthetic": True, "original_native_observed": False,

def build_saved():

    def test_source_bound_request(self):
        result = check(self.bundle)

    def test_synthetic_saved_join(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            raw = Path(tmp) / "raw.json"
            raw.write_text(json.dumps(make_raw(self.bundle)))
            saved = process(self.bundle, raw)
            self.assertEqual(saved["frames_joined"], 600)
            self.assertFalse(saved["original_native_observed"])

    def test_rehashed_track_mutation_rejected(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            bundle = Path(tmp)
            for original in self.bundle.iterdir():
                (bundle / original.name).write_bytes(original.read_bytes())
            track = bundle / "requested-tracks.jsonl"
            rows = [json.loads(line) for line in track.read_text().splitlines()]
            rows[1]["requested_other_xyz_m"][1] += 0.25
            track.write_text("".join(json.dumps(row) + "\n" for row in rows))
            cfg = json.loads((bundle / "config.json").read_text())
            import hashlib
            cfg["tracks_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(track.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            (bundle / "config.json").write_text(json.dumps(cfg))
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                check(bundle)
